meta.parties: Dias v. De Mel and Another

rules.statement: The appropriate procedure for executors to follow when seeking the discovery of movable property is through Section 712 of the Civil Procedure Code in the testamentary case, rather than under Section 669 in a separate action.
rules.supporting_quote: "To proceed by way of a separate action in the first instance would mean that neither the court administering the estate nor the creditors would be fully cognisant of the assets of the estate. In my view the proper procedure for the executors would be to act under Section 712 in the Testamentary Case bearing No. 5919/T of the District Court of Kurunegala"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 712 of the Civil Procedure Code
